Fentanyl is one of the leading causes of death for young Americans & under the Biden Admin’s open-border agenda, fentanyl is flowing across our border at record levels.
This is a public health CRISIS & President Biden must secure the border & stop the surge of these deadly drugs.

Great visit to the TX Health Huguley Hospital to address a variety of issues from expanding telehealth options & growing the healthcare workforce.

This week is National Hospital Week & I enjoyed thanking the healthcare staff for their important work to care for patients. https://t.co/DInpnOkk2f

Enjoyed meeting with hospital and community leaders at the Graham Regional Medical Center to discuss the issues most important to the rural healthcare industry and ways to expand telehealth access. #TX25 https://t.co/daEngFu3l6

Today I visited with the leadership of Rhino Health Inc. on how they are bringing manufacturing back to America! Their facility in Forth Worth, Texas produces protective nitrile gloves used in the healthcare, industrial, and government sectors. #MadeInAmerica https://t.co/wT3Wrj7hp3

Thousands of our nation's veterans choose to call #TX25 home.

I'm proud to represent these heroes in Congress, and will always fight for the top-notch healthcare, compensation, and benefits they deserve.

This morning I had the opportunity to visit @texashealth Arlington Memorial Hospital to participate in a roundtable and meet with local healthcare leaders to hear about their legislative priorities and tour the emergency department. https://t.co/Ea3dDQdLOO

I will always stand for our brave men and women in uniform and fight to keep our nation secure.

✔️ Support our troops
✔️ Invest in an efficient, effective military
✔️ Exercise peace through strength with our allies to counter increasing global threats

The U.S. should never be reliant on foreign countries for critical supplies like energy, medicine, and technology.

@HouseGOP has a plan to maximize reliable American-made energy, expand U.S. manufacturing, and move supply chains away from China.

Thousands of our nation's heroes choose to call #TX25 home.

It is a privilege to represent these heroes in Congress, and I will always fight to ensure they have the healthcare, compensation, and benefits that they earned during their military service.

Americans are paying more for just about everything thanks to #Bidenflation.

🚘 Car insurance up 19.2%
🚊 Transportation services up 9.2%
🍼 Baby food and formula up 8.3%
🏘️ Rent up 7.2%

Democrats' reckless spending and failed policies are stretching hardworking families thin.

The American people deserve transparency and accountability. The formal impeachment inquiry passed by @HouseGOP sets forth specific procedures that will allow the House to exercise its Constitutional power and hold Biden accountable!

Of Biden's $14 billion supplemental funding request, just over $2.3 billion would actually go to Border Patrol operations. Even this will only manage the crisis through processing tents, medical services, consumables, etc.

This will only incentivize more people to come.

The numbers don't lie... #Bidenomics is not cutting it for hardworking American families.

⛽️ Gas prices remain about 30% higher today than the day Biden took office.
⚡️ Electricity: UP 25%
🍴 Food prices: UP 20.2%
🏘️ Rent: UP 18.6%
🚘Car insurance: UP 20.3%

Criminals have taken over our country and it is devastating small businesses, costing on average over $1,600 a MONTH, with 90% of small businesses having been impacted.

https://t.co/KtJZNSa2j0

I spoke to the Consumer Credit Industry Association about how the CFPB is overreaching in their attempt to regulate the business of insurance. Overburdening regulations and red tape are hurting Main Street. https://t.co/eCWJypLTc8

For too long, Biden has piled burdensome regulations onto our financial institutions without considering the impacts.

Our financial regulators should be focusing on the health of the financial sector and promoting competition.

Read my release ⬇️

https://t.co/UzMJW0e9X7

I introduced a resolution to designate July 17, 2024 as “Glioblastoma Awareness Day.”

This resolution increases awareness, which is critical to research and treatment advancements, and brings hope to those fighting this devastating disease. https://t.co/ciapCr8hGU

This afternoon I met with leaders of Texas Health Harris Methodist in Stephenville to tour their emergency center and hear about issues impacting their industry and ways I can help in Congress. https://t.co/bPOv6MTQkH

This administration is incentivizing a deadly invasion on American soil.

Free hotels, healthcare, and debit cards have attracted thousands of illegal migrants.

Border Czar Harris has turned every community into a border community.

Over the past year, 825,000 Americans lost employment while 1.2 million foreign-born workers gained employment.

Taxpayer dollars are funding migrant travel and housing while veterans sleep on the streets.

Illegal immigrants are thriving under Kamala Harris. Americans are not.

In Harris’ America, taxpayer dollars are funding migrant travel and housing while veterans sleep on the streets and hard working American families are forced to choose between putting gas in the car or food on the table.

Illegal immigrants are thriving while Americans suffer.

My prayers are with Mia Love and her family as she fights glioblastoma.

I lost my wife, Patty, in January to this devastating disease and I will always be grateful for Mia’s large role in getting her into Duke where she received treatment.

May God be with her family during this difficult time.

Today marks the first day of Brain Tumor Awareness Month.

Thank you to the caregivers, healthcare professionals, researchers, and advocates whose tireless work brings us closer to a future without brain cancer.

May we honor the strength, resilience, and unwavering dedication of those who are still fighting today.

I introduced a resolution in support of Glioblastoma Awareness Day.

My resolution increases glioblastoma awareness, which is critical to research and treatment advancements, and expresses support for those battling this disease.

May we honor the strength and resilience of those fighting today and those we have lost.

https://t.co/nGQMNVvsPM
I am saddened to hear of former President Biden’s cancer diagnosis. I wish him the best during this difficult time and pray for his full recovery.
